title: smime-tree: NoRevocationCheck needs prominent security warning in doc
description: NoRevocationCheck is a production-visible type with a benign name. Callers who use it without reading docs silently disable all revocation checking. The current doc says 'use when... during testing' without urgency. Add a # Security section to its doc comment: 'This disables all OCSP and CRL checks. Never use in production without explicit out-of-band revocation handling.'
